caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, showing both its front and left side. The chair features four curved legs and a decorative backrest with turned spindles and carved detailing at the top. The seat is upholstered with a patterned green fabric, which includes a geometric repeating design in various colors. The wood of the chair appears dark brown with lighter highlights to suggest shape and shine. The chair is centered against a plain, light beige background with no other objects or elements present in the composition.
